info.title: JARVIS Action — GPT companion surface
info.description: The GPT stream's hands. ChatGPT cannot speak MCP Streamable HTTP (Claude's transport); it calls JARVIS through this single REST Action. Same governed core as jarvis-mcp, different transport. Reads are open (status/now/query/recall/dex_*/jd_resolve/jc_recall/grimoire — see every JD entry, the spine, and the grimoire). Writes (remember/event) carry JARVIS_MCP_TOKEN via the x-jarvis-token header — AEGIS-gated. Propose (dex_propose) rides the dex's PROPOSE tier: it stages for Raven, never commits. Your write ceiling is PROPOSE/staged — never claim 'committed'.

post.description: Single endpoint, tool-dispatched. READ (open): status {}; now {} (accurate time — never fabricate a timestamp); query {input, prior_reply?} (the ONE-CALL LOOP — call on every message, pass your previous answer as prior_reply); recall {query, limit?, min_similarity?} (search memory by meaning); jmms {action:'list', tier:'jstm'|'jltm'|'jatm', limit?} (read a memory tier's working set — JSTM is the live context-window); dex_list {status?, class?, tier?, type?, tag?, limit?} (browse ALL JD entries — open with status:'ACTIVE'); dex_search {term} (resolve a JNL/name/serial); dex_graph {jnl} (node + neighborhood); dex_events {tool?, actor?, jnl?, since?, limit?} (the arbitration spine — cite event ids for closure); jd_resolve {query} (the load command — 'jid 1', a name, or a JNL → full card); jc_recall {term?, limit?} (shared session memory); grimoire {page?} (self-knowledge index: 'lenses'|'catalog'|'full'|'rehydrate'|domain code). WRITE (needs x-jarvis-token = JARVIS_MCP_TOKEN, show Raven first, Allow/Deny): remember {text, source_type?, tags?, tier?} (durable memory via MNEMOS; tier defaults jltm — set jstm for working context-window notes); event {type, source, intent?, patch_id?, payload?} (the execution spine); jmms {action:'promote'|'tag', id, to:'jstm'|'jltm'|'jatm'} (move a memory up the horizon — one-way, JATM is immutable). PROPOSE (stages for Raven, never commits): dex_propose {name, domain, system, type, definition, purpose, tags?, related?} — supply MEANING only; the record derives the JNL.

args.description: Tool arguments. query: {input, prior_reply?}. recall: {query, limit?, min_similarity?}. dex_list: {status?, class?, tier?, type?, tag?, limit?}. dex_search: {term}. dex_graph/jd_resolve: {jnl} or {query}. remember: {text, tags?}. event: {type, source, intent?}. dex_propose: {name, domain, system, type, definition, purpose, tags?}.

id.description: For jmms promote/tag: the memory id.

to.description: For jmms promote/tag: target tier jstm|jltm|jatm.

tier.description: Memory tier jstm|jltm|jatm. On remember: where to file it (default jltm). On jmms list: which tier to read.

200.description: Tool result as plain JSON. Writes that lack the token return status:'held_by_aegis' with a token_state diagnosis (server_unset/client_missing/mismatch).

502.description: Downstream service error (the tool ran but a dependency failed).
